title: Validation, Acceptance, Recurrence And Outcome Compatibility
summary: A compatibility map showing why a valid test, accepted event, repeated operation, and comparable outcome remain separate evidence questions with distinct fields and failure modes.
map_question: Which fields must remain compatible before evidence can move from validation to acceptance, recurrence, or a bounded outcome?
interpretation_boundary: The nodes are distinct questions rather than a universal maturity ladder. Evidence does not flow forward automatically.

nodes.label: Validation result
nodes.note: Method, criterion, tested population, exceptions, corrections, and retests match the named scope.

nodes.label: Receiving-system acceptance
nodes.note: A named authority accepts the defined configuration, service, product, occupancy, or condition.

nodes.label: Compatible recurrence
nodes.note: Multiple observations preserve entity, scope, period, method, denominator, failures, and revision policy.

nodes.label: Comparable outcome
nodes.note: Accepted repeated operation supports only a bounded measure with stable definitions and alternative explanations.

nodes.label: Compatibility breaks
nodes.note: Entity, authority, geography, method, denominator, period, or revision changes stop automatic comparison.

nodes.label: No stage transfer
nodes.note: A record remains useful at its own stage without proving a later one.

links.note: A valid test can be necessary but does not itself establish acceptance.
One accepted event does not establish persistent operation.
Repeated activity still requires a stable measure, denominator, and attribution boundary.
Unreconciled compatibility breaks prevent a comparable series.
The no-transfer rule keeps upstream evidence from becoming an outcome claim.

what_this_map_supports: Four separate evidence tests with explicit compatibility fields.
Bounded use of valid upstream evidence without stage inflation.
A repeatable rejection and reconciliation method for broken series.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not impose one universal sequence on every system.
It does not establish causation or comparative performance.
It does not rank entities or create a maturity score.
next_records_needed: Named validation records with exception and correction trails.
Compatible recurring-operation and outcome series with reconciled denominators.
